Bitget trading journal

Connect Bitget with a key that can only read. MarginPad Journal imports the last three months of your USDT-M futures, rebuilds every position from the fills and shows what each trade really made after fees and funding - and how much you could keep. Free.

Connect BitgetSee the journal

Make the key in two minutes

  1. On Bitget open API Management, press Create API and choose System-generated API key.
  2. Name it and set a passphrase - the journal asks for it.
  3. Permissions: choose Read-only; leave trade, transfer and withdraw off.
  4. Bind IP: paste 167.172.98.147 and confirm.
IP to bind: 167.172.98.147

Every request to Bitget comes from that one server, so a key bound to it is useless anywhere else.

Questions

Which Bitget permission is needed?

Read-only. We read the key's authorities from Bitget and refuse any that can trade, transfer or use P2P.

Does it read copy-trading positions?

It reads the futures fills on the account the key belongs to.

How far back?

Bitget serves three months of fill history; the journal keeps everything from then on.

What does it cost?

Nothing. No card and no trial that ends.
